# Variable `SSTATE_SKIP_CREATION`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

The SSTATE_SKIP_CREATION variable can be used to skip the creation of shared state tarball files. It makes sense e.g. for image creation tasks as tarring images and keeping them in sstate would consume a lot of disk space.

In general it is not recommended to use this variable as missing sstate artefacts adversely impact the build, particularly for entries in the middle of dependency chains. The case it can make sense is where the size and time costs of the artefact are similar to just running the tasks. This generally only applies to end artefact output like images.

The syntax to disable it for one task is:

```
SSTATE_SKIP_CREATION:task-image-complete = "1"

```

The syntax to disable it for the whole recipe is:

```
SSTATE_SKIP_CREATION = "1"

```

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SSTATE_SKIP_CREATION
